_comment: The sample hub that Start copies out on a first run. It declares TWO Spaces of its own, and the shipped config.default.json adds the third (Azure demo) -- three demo Spaces, one per grain (D-W17), each an invitation and none required. 'demo' is the out-of-the-box Space and where Start lands: status 'local', it works from these files alone and never contacts a tracker, so it needs no login. 'github-demo' is the same RecipeBox product tracked on GitHub, pointing at the public repo johnfrog76/recipe-box-demo (seeded once by samples/seed-recipe-box.ps1); it ships 'local' too, so a cold machine never reads it as unreachable, and the connect wizard (Connect github-demo, /connect/github-demo) turns it active once gh is signed in -- or points it at your own repo. Its address is a public repo, which is why it is declared HERE and not in config.default.json, where Portability Clause 2a refuses any real address. sprintAwareness is off: the sprint charts read the hub's history, and a hub copied a minute ago has none -- a row of zeros is a poor first thing to show. laneNames are Demo's own words for the four lanes -- To do, Doing, Waiting, Done -- for someone with no team and no tracker; a Space that says nothing gets Active, In Progress, Code Review, Done. Display only.
